gait.source: Retain actual11999 gait1.0 using original bound source default0.5 override; no reward change relative to actual parent.

command_provenance: Exact saved12700 command ranges. Two of ten environment-index groups use the matched yaw audit vx and yaw magnitude. Both begin straight, then group 0 receives positive yaw and group 1 negative yaw. Original standing selection takes priority and the other groups retain the native sampler.
hypothesis: r41 walks, sustains right turn (2nd-half increment ~-0.10) and keeps foot tilt; its stop ankles still swing. Add ONLY a half-strength (-0.05) zero-command ankle action-rate term so the stop is quieter without the r44 over-constraint that zeroed the second-half right-turn pull and worsened speed/tilt.
side_effects: A finite ankle action-rate cost under exactly zero command can resist ankle reactions or delay stopping; weaker than r44 -0.10. Protect signed right turn (incl 17-23s increment vs straight), forward speed MAE, route, left-foot loaded tilt and no-fall.

std.source: Single-variable contrast from the exact saved12700 runtime: only the yaw tracking kernel std moves 0.1->0.3 rad/s; original bound source default0.5 is overridden to this target.

contact_lateral_tilt.source: Reconstruct exact saved12700 bilateral normal-force weighted moving cost from the original base.

zero_command_ankle_action_rate_l2.source: Half-strength stop constraint (r45): -0.05 gives ~0.47-0.53x the whole-body action-rate at late stop on r41 frames. Training-only reward on the 4 ankle raw-action increments under exactly zero command; retain r41 turn/speed/route/foot-tilt.
